name: Metalurgica Gerdau S.A.
summary: Metalurgica Gerdau S.A., together with its subsidiaries, produces and supplies long steel products in Brazil, the Americas, and internationally. The company offers rebars, profiles, wires, thick plates, hot-rolled coils, billets, blooms, plates, wire rod, structural profiles, and flat steel and iron ore, as well as bars, including special steels. Metalurgica Gerdau S.A.was formerly known as METALÚRGICA HUGO GERDAU S.A and changed its name to Metalurgica Gerdau S.A. in June 1965. Metalurgica Gerdau S.A. was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. Metalurgica Gerdau S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Indac - Indústria, Administração e Comércio S.A.
